summary: Steel lookout on the Crab Orchard refuge, Williamson County, IL; standing by 1960, staffed by Gordon Tripp for 20 years, later removed; removal date not found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel tower with an observation room at the top
facts.status_note: Listed as removed; the sources read give no removal date.

visit.trail_note: No tower remains to climb. The site is on refuge land; no source describes present-day access.

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey describes the tower on refuge property, overall height about 110 feet

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1960 Coast and Geodetic Survey record gives about 110 feet overall; Illinois Country Living calls the tower 100-foot-tall. height_m is left out of facts and both figures appear in the story.

notes_for_editor: Build date not found; the 1960 survey shows the tower standing by then. Removal date not found. Height differs between the survey (about 110 ft overall) and the article (100 ft). Access level omitted: the refuge is partly open for recreation, but no source says which part holds the site. The brief's record (gone, Williamson County, coordinates) checks out. No new photos found.
